metadata.question: Did the burned area north and west of Pacific Palisades, California increase between January 6, 2025 and January 14, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Burned Area MCD64A1 v6.1 for January 2025 over a polygon north and west of Pacific Palisades. Compare cumulative burned area where BurnDate ≤ 6 vs ≤ 14. If MCD64A1 not available, fall back to Sentinel-2 SR to estimate burned area via NBR thresholds on small date windows around Jan 6 and Jan 14.
2. Masking strategy: MCD64A1 is already processed (no cloud masking needed). Sentinel-2 fallback uses SCL-based cloud/shadow masking.
3. Logic for valid zero vs null: If collections empty → C1. If images exist but no valid pixels after masking → C2. If reduce results are null/NaN without valid pixel support → C3. Otherwise, compare areas; delta > 0 means increase (A), else (B).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [-118.62, 34.03],
      [-118.62, 34.15],
      [-118.47, 34.15],
      [-118.47, 34.03]
    ]);
    const start6 = '2025-01-01';
    const end6 = '2025-01-07';   // inclusive window around Jan 6 for fallback
    const start14 = '2025-01-12';
    const end14 = '2025-01-16';  // inclusive window around Jan 14 for fallback
    const scale = 1000;

    // Helper to safely get number from reduceRegion
    async function getNumber(dict, key, defaultVal = 0) {
      const v = await ee.Number(ee.Dictionary(dict).get(key)).getInfo();
      if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) return defaultVal;
      return v;
    }

    // 2. Primary Data Acquisition & Check: MODIS MCD64A1 Burned Area
    let usedMCD = false;
    try {
      const mcd = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1')
        .filterDate('2025-01-01', '2025-02-01')
        .filterBounds(roi);
      const mcdSize = await mcd.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`MCD64A1 Jan2025 Images: ${mcdSize}`);
      if (mcdSize > 0) {
        const img = ee.Image(mcd.first());
        const bd = img.select('BurnDate'); // day-of-year, 0 == unburned
        // Validate there are valid pixels in ROI
        const validDict = await bd.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e12,
          tileScale: 4
        }).getInfo();
        const validPx = await getNumber(validDict, 'BurnDate', 0);
        console.log(`MCD64A1 Valid px: ${validPx}`);
        if (validPx === 0) {
          console.log('No valid pixels in ROI for MCD64A1.');
        } else {
          // Burned by Jan 6 and by Jan 14
          const burned6 = bd.gt(0).and(bd.lte(6));
          const burned14 = bd.gt(0).and(bd.lte(14));
          const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area');

          const area6Dict = await areaImg.updateMask(burned6).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: roi,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e12,
            tileScale: 4
          }).getInfo();
          const area14Dict = await areaImg.updateMask(burned14).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: roi,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e12,
            tileScale: 4
          }).getInfo();

          const px6Dict = await ee.Image(1).updateMask(burned6).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: roi,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e12,
            tileScale: 4
          }).getInfo();
          const px14Dict = await ee.Image(1).updateMask(burned14).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: roi,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e12,
            tileScale: 4
          }).getInfo();

          const area6_m2 = await getNumber(area6Dict, 'area', 0);
          const area14_m2 = await getNumber(area14Dict, 'area', 0);
          const px6 = await getNumber(px6Dict, 'constant', 0);
          const px14 = await getNumber(px14Dict, 'constant', 0);

          const area6_ha = area6_m2 / 10000.0;
          const area14_ha = area14_m2 / 10000.0;
          const delta_ha = area14_ha - area6_ha;

          console.log(`Burned by Jan 6, 2025: ${area6_ha.toFixed(2)} ha (px: ${px6})`);
          console.log(`Burned by Jan 14, 2025: ${area14_ha.toFixed(2)} ha (px: ${px14})`);
          console.log(`Increase (14 - 6): ${delta_ha.toFixed(2)} ha`);

          // 5. Validation & Final Answer
          if (!isFinite(area6_ha) || !isFinite(area14_ha)) {
            console.log('C3');
            return;
          }
          console.log(delta_ha > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
          usedMCD = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(`MCD64A1 Processing Error: ${e}`);
      // fall through to fallback
    }
    if (usedMCD) return;

    // 2b. Fallback: Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized with cloud masking and NBR
    function maskS2(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const good = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)).or(scl.eq(6)).or(scl.eq(7)).or(scl.eq(11));
      return img.updateMask(good);
    }
    function compositeNBR(start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 70))
        .map(maskS2)
        .select(['B8', 'B12', 'SCL']);
      return {
        collection: col,
        image: col.median().addBands(col.select('B8')).addBands(col.select('B12'))
      };
    }
    const c6 = compositeNBR(start6, end6);
    const c14 = compositeNBR(start14, end14);
    const n6 = await c6.collection.size().getInfo();
    const n14 = await c14.collection.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`S2 images Jan6-window: ${n6}, Jan14-window: ${n14}`);
    if (n6 === 0 || n14 === 0) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    // Compute NBR and valid pixel counts
    function nbrFrom(img) {
      const nbr = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B12']).rename('NBR');
      return nbr;
    }
    const nbr6 = nbrFrom(c6.image);
    const nbr14 = nbrFrom(c14.image);

    const valid6 = await nbr6.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const valid14 = await nbr14.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const v6 = await getNumber(valid6, 'NBR', 0);
    const v14 = await getNumber(valid14, 'NBR', 0);
    console.log(`S2 valid px: Jan6=${v6}, Jan14=${v14}`);
    if (v6 === 0 || v14 === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Burned mask using NBR threshold (lower NBR indicates burn/scar)
    const burnedThresh = 0.1;
    const burned6 = nbr6.lte(burnedThresh);
    const burned14 = nbr14.lte(burnedThresh);
    const areaImg30 = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area');

    const area6Dict = await areaImg30.updateMask(burned6).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const area14Dict = await areaImg30.updateMask(burned14).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 30,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const area6_m2 = await getNumber(area6Dict, 'area', 0);
    const area14_m2 = await getNumber(area14Dict, 'area', 0);
    const area6_ha = area6_m2 / 10000.0;
    const area14_ha = area14_m2 / 10000.0;
    const delta_ha = area14_ha - area6_ha;

    // Approx cloudiness: median of CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE
    const cloud6 = await c6.collection.aggregate_median('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo();
    const cloud14 = await c14.collection.aggregate_median('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo();

    console.log(`S2 Cloud % (median): Jan6=${(cloud6 ?? -1).toFixed ? cloud6.toFixed(1) : cloud6}, Jan14=${(cloud14 ?? -1).toFixed ? cloud14.toFixed(1) : cloud14}`);
    console.log(`S2 Burned by Jan 6: ${area6_ha.toFixed(2)} ha`);
    console.log(`S2 Burned by Jan 14: ${area14_ha.toFixed(2)} ha`);
    console.log(`S2 Increase (14 - 6): ${delta_ha.toFixed(2)} ha`);

    if (!isFinite(area6_ha) || !isFinite(area14_ha)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(delta_ha > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`D`);
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
